messages:
elena: Hey team — onboarding runs in staging suddenly started failing last night. Main symptom is a cluster of 401s then a bunch of 429s during our SDK init step. Happens only from CI runners behind our corp proxy. Tried rerun, same. Anyone seen keepalive/proxy weirdness before?

maria: Ugh. Can you paste a short log excerpt + SDK version?

elena: SDK v0.9.7, using ephemeral tokens from our session service. Logs:
```
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z INFO sdk:init connecting to api.redwood:443
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z WARN auth:preflight status=401 message="invalid_token"
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z INFO retrying preflight attempt=2
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z ERROR server:rate_limited status=429 message="preflight_quota_exceeded"
```

elena: We see ~200 parallel CI jobs hitting preflight in bursts due to parallel test matrix.

devin: Interesting — corp proxy likely holding HTTP/2 connections open and reusing TLS sessions. If ephemeral token rotation happens while keepalive is used, some preflight attempts might present stale session state and backend rejects -> then SDK retries and floods preflight quota, hitting 429.

troy: Can you share CI runner config? Are you reusing containers between jobs?

elena: Yes, runners reuse a warm pool of containers to speed up tests. We also enabled http2 keepalive in the node runtime.

maria: Two quick mitigations to try: 1) reduce preflight concurrency / add jitter/splay on token fetch, 2) disable HTTP/2 keepalive (or set Connection: close) in the SDK HTTP agent behind your proxy. Both should prevent the connection reuse + rotate race.

devin: Also check ephemeral token lifetime and clock drift on runners — if tokens are rotated aggressively (<60s) we see more windowed failures.

elena: Trying change #1 now — set concurrency cap to 8 and add random backoff 50-200ms. Will report in ~10m.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-18T02:20:00Z started for staging (commit abc123) :rocket:

elena: Quick test after cap applied: preflight 401s dropped almost entirely, 429s reduced from ~30/min to 2/min. Looks promising.

troy: Nice. We should still harden SDK: add Connection header override option and automatic splay on preflight when running in parallel environments. I can open an eng ticket.

devin: Filed INF-2042: \"SDK: add Connection: close toggle and preflight splay by default in CI mode\" — assigned to eng-runtime.

maria: For onboarding playbook: recommend customers behind proxies to (a) cap preflight concurrency, (b) enable token caching or bundle token fetches, (c) disable long HTTP/2 keepalives on proxy or set Connection: close, (d) ensure runner clocks in sync.

elena: Thanks everyone — will keep the run throttled and follow up tomorrow after a full pipeline run. :thumbsup:

maria: Marking as tracked in the onboarding checklist and pinging the customer success doc owners to add the proxy note.

elena: Final note — workaround: we added a tiny token-cache shim in the CI container (20s window) which stabilized everything while we wait for SDK fix.

devin: Great workaround. Please paste the snippet you used so we can add to the KB.

elena: Snippet (bash):
```bash
# simple ephemeral token cache in CI container
TOKFILE=/tmp/epi_token
if [ -f "$TOKFILE" ] && [ $(($(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y $TOKFILE))) -lt 20 ]; then
  cat $TOKFILE
else
  curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_SERVICE_TOKEN' https://internal/session-svc/ephemeral > $TOKFILE
  cat $TOKFILE
fi
```

maria: Perfect — we'll add that to onboarding notes and close once SDK change rolls out.

elena: Closing for now, will reopen if it resurfaces. Thanks all.
